_about: Explicitly reviewed exceptions for the AX-case migration. A legacy record whose sole URL trips the suspicious-URL guard (looks like a feed, search page, or index rather than the case's own page) is reported UNMAPPABLE and is not migrated. It can only be admitted by being listed here with a human reviewer note, or by passing --allow-unmappable.
_guard_about: The guard NEVER silently reinterprets or rewrites a URL. It only refuses. Rules that trip it are listed in src/harvest/migrate/ax_cases.py and reported by rule id alongside each rejection.
_expected_state: Against the corpus at implementation start (231 cases, all source_url values being article pages such as uber.com/blog/... and github.blog/...), zero rejections are expected. The count is asserted by the migration test, not assumed.

_reviewed_unmappable_shape.note: Why this URL is in fact the case's own page despite tripping the guard, or why it is correctly excluded.
